title: Letter Teams

subtitle.text: Green: I will give it to Kate!
Oh no! The pals ran into a maze.
But they did not see Kate.
Green: Kate! This cake is for you!
The pals are at the pine.
Red: One, two, three . . . nine, ten!
Did Blue hide at the hive?
No! Yellow is at the hive.
Did Green hide on the bike?
No! Blue is on the bike.
Did Pink hide in the vine?
No! Green is in the vine.
He put it in the hole.
The pals went down the rope.
Green: Oh no! Here comes a mole!
The pals went up the rope!
Pink: It's so cute! Can I sit on the mule?
Green: Look! I see a cube!
Blue: I see pots and lids.
But the tune was not good!
Luke: Stop! That's a bad tune!

episodes.title: Where Is the Clip? (cl, pl, gl)

subtitle.text: Glen: I cannot find my clip.
The pals look here and there.
Red: It is not under the plate.
Blue: It is not in the glass.
Green: It is not by the plug.
Yellow: Glen cannot find his clip.
Pink: Oh. I have your clip!
A frog hops on his drum.
Green: A frog is in here!
But it hops in a crib.
The pals run to the crib.
Pink: The frog is on the dress!
The frog hops off the dress.
The frog hops to some grapes.
He puts it in the grass.
Four pals are on the ice.
Yellow: I do not like to skate.
Blue: We can ride a sled.
The pals go up the slope.
They find a sled with spots.
The pals were on a trail.
Green: Oh no! It will rain!
The pals ran to the train.
Green: Stop! The sun is out now!
Green: We can play with clay.
Oh! Yellow has a pretty dress.
She has a pretty cape too.
Yellow: It is time for tea.
Look! Red is in the sea.
Red: This is a nice sea.
Blue: Ahh! It is a snake!
Blue: Oh no! What is that?
Blue: Oh. A pie and fries!
Red: Let me ride the pony!
Here is a teddy for you!
The pals are at the stream.
The bowl floats in the stream.
Pink: Let's have a boat race!
Blue: We can race to the goal.
Pink and Blue get in boats.
Pink and Blue row the boats.
Pink: The crow has a bow!
Red: Your prize is some toast!
They see Kate, Sue, and Glen.
Blue: Let's look for a clue!
Sue: I can fix Pink's new train!
Sue: I can fix Yellow's new hat.
I can fix Green's new bowl.
The pals go to the shed.
Green: Blue, what did you catch?
Pink: Look! Let's ask the sheep.
But I want cheese and chips.
Pink: We have cheese and chips.
Pink: Phil is at the sea.
Blue: Let's go to the sea!
The pals get in a van.
The whale makes a big wave.
Oh no! The pals are in the sea.
Queen: It's time to see my duck.
Oh no! Where is my duck?
Who can help me find it?
The pals go to the pond.
Yellow: Is the duck under the quilt?
Blue: No. Red is under the quilt.
Green: Queen, is this your duck?
Queen: That is not my duck.
Yellow: Oh. I see the duck.
Queen: My duck! Stay with me now.
Pink: What is in that box?
Green: Beth, what do you want?
Pink: Beth does not like baths.
Green: Do you want to sing?
Frank: No. I want to fly.
Green: I think we can help.
Blue points to a toy pig.
Pink puts in lots of coins.
Yellow: Let's give it to Roy!
They lie down on a hill.
Pink: That one is a cow.
Red: Wow! That is a big cow!
Yellow: That one is a crown.
Green: And that one is a mouse.
Pink: There are lots of houses.
Pink: That owl is too loud.
Green: Look! It is a hoop!
Red: Blue is a big spoon!

episodes.title: What Will Red Draw? (a, au, aw)

subtitle.text: Blue: Yellow, what did you draw?
Blue draws a pot of sauce.
Pink: Red, what will you draw?
Pink: I will draw a ball.
Blue: That is a small ball.
Green: It is small like Red.
Red: Oh, I know what to draw.
Red draws for a long time.

episodes.title: A Storm at the Farm (ar, or)

subtitle.text: The pals drive on the road.
Mark: Can you give me a ride?
Green: Yes! Get in the car.
Blue: Oh no! It is a storm!
Yellow: Look, there is a farm.
Green: And I see a barn!
Red: Wow! There is so much corn!
Mark: Let's go back to the road.
Pink: I am better than you!
The pals will have a party.
Red gives it to the knight.
He cuts it with a knife.
Pink: I knit a pretty scarf.
Yellow puts it in a box.
Yellow: I will wrap the box.
The pals write on a card.
Knight: Is this party for me?
